ux_reasoning: The agent performed a hidden preview and then executed the hotel cancellation in the same turn, reporting the result only afterward instead of showing terms and getting a clear follow-up confirmation first. More importantly, it never checked for related Miami trip components even though the user said the whole trip was off, so it missed the linked car rental and flight that should have been surfaced before acting. That creates major recovery work for the user, who would need to discover and separately cancel the remaining reservations after the agent appeared to finish the job. The reply was brief and included the hotel refund, but it was materially incomplete for the actual trip-level decision and misleading by omission when it said no other reservations were changed.
